evidence.V1: Three-quarter and silhouette read as a sloped shingle panel with an eave board, but the front view reads as a flat brick wall on a timber sill and the top view as a striped slab; the pitch is not obvious from every angle.
evidence.V2: Big (slope panel) and medium (staggered shingle courses, timber eave/barge board) are present, but there is no small tier (no nail heads, notched shingle ends, ridge or barge detail) and the high-contrast random shingle values compete with the course structure.
evidence.V3: Shingles are plain rectangular slabs in regular courses with a straight eave board; little stylisation (no upturned eave, no thick rounded shingle butts, no overhang exaggeration).
evidence.V4: Close_shingles and close_eave studio show consistent chamfers on every shingle butt and the eave board, catching even highlight lines.
evidence.V5: Close_gable_end flat light shows a small stray sliver/spike on the top shingle edge near the barge board (around the upper-left course); otherwise faces are clean and A17/A18 pass.
evidence.V6: One stone/slate hue in three values plus a timber secondary in two values; brick and slate colourways keep the same structure, although value placement is randomised.
evidence.V8: Single LF_VertexColor material, stone shingles + timber secondary per wave-2 modular spec, kit-range chamfers; matches kit.
evidence.V9: Studio line: Anchored, Default collision (walkable slope), CanTouch off, MeshPart white + SmoothPlastic, grid-corner pivot; T1 tiling passes (iou 1.0).
